ara: morning async — quick check-in (what I did / blockers / today)

ara: Did: landed microbatch scheduler tweak (PR #4821) -> ~7% p95 token latency reduction on perf-bench v2. Ran 2h bench on dev pool, results attached to PR.

ara: Blocker: KV warmup still flaky on canary: saw OOM on run 03: "kv_evict: unable to allocate slab". Suspect race between prefetch and eviction.

ara: Today: triage canary logs, add a short repro and try forcing prefetch backoff. If I can't stabilize, will roll back the tweak for canary.

kai: Nice! Can you paste the bench command you ran so I can reproduce locally?

ara: Sure — run this from infra-tools:
```
bench-run --suite perf-v2 --model redwood-13b --seq 1024 --concurrency 16 --duration 7200 --prefetch 1
```
Also capture `dmesg | tail` after OOM.

sam: I'll try to repro on my workstation (A100-40). If it's an eviction timing issue we may need a tighter lock around slab free. I'll ping after first run.

natalie: Can we add a unit that toggles prefetch backoff in the CI smoke? Quick test that does a tiny warmup and checks memory under load. :mag: 

mike: skimmed PR #4821 — lgtm for logic, left one nit about a race comment.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: redwood-runtime/canary/prime-2026-03-17 started — 3/5 hosts healthy, continuing rollout.

ci-bot: perf-bench(v2) triggered for PR #4821 — queued on dev-pool-3.

ara: Thanks — @sam @natalie if either of you finds a tight repro, drop it here and I'll pair. If not, I'll open a rollback PR tonight.

kai: ack, standing by. :thumbsup:
